versions.title: Unhurried startups, cleaner game page
improved: Every console now gets the full start animation (Play and Resume from Home no longer use the 1 second version), and the startup sound plays out before the game appears
GameCube, PlayStation and Wii U discs take their time: the lid or tray opens, the disc settles, and it closes
The game page is decluttered: cover, title, one line of facts, Play / Play Online, and tabs for About, Saves, Screenshots and Settings. Empty sections are hidden
fixed: Your console's own startup (IPL/BIOS) no longer cuts the animation short

versions.title: GameCube online stays up
improved: RetroHub keeps a small online log (userdata\logs\online.log) so dropped GameCube sessions can be diagnosed
fixed: A GameCube guest's game is no longer closed the moment the host's connection blips: RetroHub waits, tells you the host disconnected, and lets you choose when to leave

versions.title: Online badges that match
fixed: Every game that can be played online now shows the online globe in the library and counts in the Online filter (for example GameCube games like Super Mario Strikers that aren't in the featured list)

versions.title: The real console startup, and better-looking consoles
new: Real console startup: games can boot through your own console BIOS so the genuine startup plays (PS1 and PS2 with your BIOS; GameCube with your IPL.bin; Game Boy, GBA and DS with their boot files). Turn it on or off per console in Settings
Custom startup sounds: drop a .wav, .ogg or .mp3 named after the console into userdata\boot_sounds and it plays at game start
improved: Every console, cartridge and disc in the start animation is redrawn to look like the real hardware
More lifelike start animation: carts line up and seat into the slot, lids hinge open, discs tumble and spin

versions.title: Longer startup sounds, zipped games everywhere
new: Every console's startup sound is now a fuller 5-10 second piece that keeps playing as the game starts
Zip, 7z and rar work for every console: small games load straight away, big disc games unpack once and are reused
Settings shows how much space unpacked games use, with Clear cache and a size limit
improved: Zipped and unzipped copies count as the same game, so saves, cloud saves and online rooms match across friends
Library scanning is about twice as fast
Updates now come from the RetroHub releases page and are quicker to publish
fixed: Friends' games now show their cover art (for example PlayStation games when you own none)

versions.title: A calmer start animation
improved: The game start animation takes its time: the cartridge or disc lines up over the console, slides in, and settles before the power comes on
Remote play for Wii U: groundwork so Cemu picks up remote players' controllers as players 2-4

versions.title: GameCube online: faster and rock solid
improved: GameCube online gets into the game about twice as fast (around 20 seconds from Launch)
Passed 140 of 140 stress-test games (direct, relay, bad connections, late or slow players) with no desyncs
fixed: Players with the same GameCube game in different file formats (.iso, .ciso, .rvz) can now play together; only a genuinely different version is refused, with a clear message
The host is told right away when a guest can't start, instead of waiting

versions.title: NES, SNES, Wii U couch co-op and a lot more
new: NES and SNES are here: online play with rollback, multitap support, cheats and game info
Wii U remote play for couch co-op (3D World and friends): only the host needs the game, and a direct connection is required
PlayStation 2 online for 2 players
A game start animation with startup sounds, plus controller tips when a game starts
Game info with descriptions and ratings
Your friends' games show greyed out in your library, so you can see what you could play together
See your friends' play time
Cheats can take typed values
Buzz! buzzers are supported
Settings is now split into tabs
improved: Better Wii U support: proper names and cover art, updates, saves, graphic packs, and a GamePad swap with View + RB
GameCube online is more reliable: a better handshake, desync warnings and consistent settings for everyone
fixed: Online freezes and relay problems are fixed
No more terminal windows popping up
Room card fixes

versions.title: Jump back in, and play with friends faster
new: Resume from Home: the big Resume card puts you back in your last game, and save states now come with a picture so you can see where you were
In-game menu: press View + Y during a game for a quick menu, including save states for N64 games
Screenshots: take one from the in-game menu and browse them all in a gallery
Friends are playing: see on Home what your friends are playing right now, and ask to join with one click
Ping in rooms, so you can see how good everyone's connection is before you start
Play again: after a game, start another with the same people, or invite your last group in one click
Notification history in the bell, so a missed invite or request is never lost
Save history with Undo, a Needs attention filter, and export, all on the Saves page
Your stats on Home: games played, time played and your favorites
Every game can be hosted online now, with a new cover-art game picker: GameCube, PlayStation and DS games all show up, and ones we have not tested yet carry an Untested tag
Kanto Together keeps its package up to date automatically and checks that both players match before you start
improved: Home is arranged in a sensible order: Resume, Continue playing, Friends are playing, your shelves, then Your stats
Recent groups now recognise your friends by their account, so renaming yourself never breaks Play again
fixed: Pad navigation on the Saves page scrolls correctly with LT and RT again

versions.title: Cloud saves, without the folder talk
improved: Removed the old "keep your saves on all your PCs" folder card from Home: cloud saves already do that automatically
Copying saves to your own folder is now a collapsed Advanced option on the Saves page

versions.title: Cloud saves for everyone, and real usernames
new: Cloud saves are now automatic for everyone: 50 MB per account, nothing to turn on, and your saves follow you to any PC
If your saves differ between two PCs, nothing is ever lost: you choose which one to keep, and the other stays as a copy you can bring back
Restore a previous version of any save from the Saves page
Unique usernames: pick yours in setup or in Settings, and change it later (your old name stays reserved for you for a while)
Add your account to another PC with a short code, then sign in as yourself and your cloud saves come along
Add friends by their username
GameCube cheats: over 4,000 codes for 231 games (Melee unlock everything, Double Dash, Mario Party and more), applied when the game starts and synced to everyone online
improved: The Saves page shows games by their real names, a Resolve button for saves that differ, and a clear note when cloud sync is paused
A save conflict is flagged on the Saves tab and on the game, and you are asked again the next time you start the game
New accounts no longer take your Windows name by accident: you choose your username
fixed: Setup now offers the automatically-add-friends choice on its last page

versions.title: PlayStation rooms, DS and PS1 cheats, steadier online
new: PlayStation games like Crash Bash can now be picked in online rooms; the room banner tells you if a PlayStation BIOS is missing
Cheats for Nintendo DS and PlayStation games, including the built-in PlayStation cheat database
Systems without cheats (GameCube, 3DS, Wii U, PlayStation 2) now show a greyed-out Cheats button that explains why
improved: 3-4 player games keep going when one guest disconnects, instead of ending for everybody
Games that are offline-only say so, with the reason, instead of just missing the online button
3DS and Wii U launches were re-checked end to end
Docs updated to match what the app really does
fixed: A GameCube guest now closes cleanly when the host leaves
Removed the old Appear offline option, which did not behave as expected

versions.title: Multi-disc PlayStation, more cheats, smoother endings
new: PlayStation multi-disc games: swap discs from the View + Y overlay (or F10), even online
Optional second memory card for PlayStation games (per game)
GameShark button cheats for N64 now work: they fire when switched on, with an Activate button while you play
Your own Cemu install can use RetroHub's controller settings, with a one-click Restore my Cemu controls
improved: Picking a file (Cemu.exe, an account or saves file, Smash Classic) works with only a controller
Far more N64 cheats from the database work (about 2,000 more)
Non-Xbox controllers (PlayStation, 8BitDo) work in Wii U games
fixed: When the host leaves mid-game, everyone gets a clear message and returns to the room with a new host instead of waiting
Ready flags reset after a host change so Play again works

versions.title: PlayStation, cheats and full controller support
new: PlayStation 1 and PlayStation 2 games: add your discs (CHD, ISO, 7z, zip or rar) and RetroHub finds the game, its cover and your BIOS for you
PlayStation 1 online with rollback netplay, plus 4-player multitap
Cheats: a built-in database plus hand-picked unlocks for popular games, a Cheats menu on every game, and a live toggle while you play (View + Y)
Cheats back up your save first, and rooms sync the host's cheats to everyone
Use RetroHub with only a controller: every screen, popup and the new on-screen keyboard works from the pad
First-run setup wizard walks you through controller, games and name (Settings > Run setup again)
Hold Back + Start to leave any game, in every emulator
Friends are added automatically when you play together (turn it off in Settings)
What's new page and a short summary after each update
improved: Your controller settings now apply to every emulator, not just some
Smash Classic and RetroHub now share one room, so leaving in one leaves both
Game Boy and Game Boy Advance online now share the host's save so everyone sees the same progress
Add your games faster: .rar and archive files are recognised without unpacking first
Server traffic is capped to keep online play free for everyone
fixed: Rooms reset everyone's Ready state after a game ends
A failed host launch no longer leaves the room stuck
Invites to a full room are now blocked with a clear message
Nintendo DS wireless players in a room with gaps get the right slots
PlayStation 2 no longer asks to reset its settings every time it starts

versions.title: Big Ready button and smoother online
new: A big READY button (LAUNCH for the host) sits under the room code and says who is ready and why a button is disabled
Dropped rooms reconnect on their own, with a Rejoin button if needed
improved: Nintendo 64 online stays smooth: the input delay stays low (about 6 frames), recovers quickly and catches up after hiccups
If a guest can't start, the host is told why
A guest on an older RetroHub can't ready up until they update
Friend errors and invites say exactly what happened
Kanto Together saves in-progress trades with your game, and host and guest keep separate saves
Smash Classic online waits for a slow host instead of giving up, and never drops a slow player
fixed: Buttons on friend rows work on the first click, and a left click opens a friend's actions
Kanto Together can no longer start twice, and gives clear messages when something is missing

versions.title: Add your own games and a cleaner friends list
new: Add your own games: a big tile on Home, a + Add games button, or just drag files onto the window
ROMs and folders (zip and 7z too) are copied into your games folder sorted by console; your originals are never moved
Kanto Together works with an Xbox controller out of the box
improved: Old accounts of the same person are merged into their current one automatically
If two friends share a name, RetroHub asks before removing the old one
Kanto Together has first-session tips and a clear Synced to the host's story message
fixed: Kanto Together: the guest's game no longer resets after the title screen

versions.title: Kanto Together: FireRed co-op
new: Play Kanto Together, a fan-made 2-player co-op version of Pokemon FireRed, from RetroHub
Both players join a room, the host presses Launch, and the game connects your friend automatically
Room page shows connection status and a Trade panel to swap Pokemon with your partner
Built-in guide on the game's card explains the first-time setup

versions.title: 3DS online and sturdier GameCube online
new: 3DS online is on: trade and battle in Pokemon X/Y, ORAS, Sun/Moon and Ultra Sun/Moon through rooms
Each player automatically gets their own 3DS username
improved: Smash Classic online verified on every stage with 2 and 4 fighters
Mario Party 6 online checked with 3-4 players in the right controller order
fixed: GameCube online no longer stalls when the game window isn't detected on a fresh install
A lost message can no longer freeze a GameCube room

versions.title: Invite links fixed
fixed: Invite page has a big Open in RetroHub button and shows the room code
Discord now shows a proper preview of your room invite
Clicking an invite while RetroHub is closed now joins once it's ready instead of dropping it
The installer now sets RetroHub up to open invite links

versions.title: Safer updates
improved: Updates are now checked before installing, and corrupted or tampered downloads are refused

versions.title: Near-instant Pokemon trading, cloud saves on
new: Cloud saves are live: sync saves through your RetroHub account, no OneDrive needed (200 MB per player)
Game Boy and Game Boy Color link trades and battles now feel almost instant online
Clear first-launch message and friendlier ROM warnings for Smash Classic
improved: Online play is smoother on laggy connections, with far fewer pauses
Host's save is more reliable to share on slow connections
GameCube online sessions use the host's memory card and never touch guests' cards
fixed: Pokemon Emerald no longer drifts out of sync in online trades and battles
Unzipped GameCube games now offer Play Online

versions.title: Friends list fixes and Find my games
new: Find my games scans the usual places for game folders and lets you pick which to add
Windows notification when a friend invites you, without taking you out of your game
Press A to claim your player slot in Controllers before local multiplayer games
GBA link cable online now feels almost instant
fixed: Friends no longer show up twice after moving to a new PC
Only the person who received a friend request can accept it

versions.title: GBA link cable online, more controllers
new: GBA link cable online: trade and battle in Pokemon Ruby, Sapphire, Emerald, FireRed and LeafGreen
Keyboard can now be remapped, plus a Rumble Pak option for N64 games
PlayStation, Switch Pro and 8BitDo pads now work in GameCube games
improved: Game Boy and GBA online can use the host's save so different saves can't break a session
Smash Classic online is safer: strangers with a room code can't pretend to be a player
fixed: Zipped GBA and Game Boy games could fail to show up when scanning several folders
DS online now ends cleanly when a partner leaves

versions.title: Play together: online for more systems
new: GameCube online for Double Dash!!, Mario Party 6 and Melee
Game Boy and Game Boy Color link cable online for Pokemon Red, Yellow, Gold, Silver and Crystal
Online Pokemon trades and battles on 3DS and DS through rooms
Invite links: Copy invite link in a room and friends join with one click
Controllers page with remapping, per-game settings and desktop shortcuts for any game
improved: N64 online is much smoother, with input delay that adapts to your connection
fixed: Mario Party 2 and 3 no longer drift out of sync online

versions.title: GameCube games, properly
new: GameCube games in zip and 7z archives now show up with real names and covers
Dolphin downloads itself and starts games fullscreen with up to 4 controllers
GameCube saves now live in your vault and follow you across PCs
improved: 3DS and Wii U games now open fullscreen
Added Wind Waker, Twilight Princess, Double Dash, Mario Party 6, Sunshine and Melee to the catalog

versions.title: Proper names for Game Boy games
fixed: Game Boy, Game Boy Color and GBA games now show proper names and cover art and sort A-Z
Your saves are unchanged

versions.title: A real Windows installer
new: RetroHub-Setup.exe installs with a Start menu shortcut and an uninstall entry, no unzipping or admin prompt
Creates a RetroHub Games folder with a folder for each console
improved: Upgrades and uninstalls keep your saves, settings, friends account and games folder

versions.title: DS, 3DS and Wii U, rooms survive the host leaving
new: Nintendo DS support with both screens, mouse as stylus, and saves in the vault
Nintendo 3DS and Wii U support, downloaded the first time you play one
Rooms survive the host leaving: the next player becomes host and the room code keeps working
improved: Home and All Games are now organised by console, with tidier cards
Pokemon Red, Yellow, Gold, Silver and Crystal are recognised with cover art
fixed: Zipped games now unpack correctly even in deep install folders

versions.title: Leaving players no longer freeze Smash
fixed: If a player disconnects mid-match in Smash Classic online, the others no longer freeze
Their fighter is knocked out and the match carries on, and rematches work with whoever remains
The Online window now shows who left

versions.title: 4-player Smash Classic online
new: Smash Classic online now supports 3 and 4 players
In-game Online window lists every player with their fighter, connection and ping
Rematches work with 3-4 players
improved: RetroHub rooms now launch Smash Classic with 3 or 4 players
Safer lobby: bad picks from the network are rejected and two hosts can't grab the same room
fixed: Fixed a rare out-of-sync and a false out-of-sync at the start of some online matches

versions.title: Smash Remix online, smoother friends and saves
new: Smash Remix online for up to 4 players, with the full roster and costumes
One-click Use OneDrive card on Home to keep saves and friends on all your PCs
Join a friend's room even while they're mid-game
improved: Smash Classic's save now lives in your vault and syncs like every other game
Smash Classic no longer asks for its ROM again if RetroHub already found it
An empty library suggests folders that contain games
fixed: A new PC no longer overwrites your friends account when it syncs
Rooms check that everyone runs the same RetroHub version
No more double update prompts, and updates work in folders with non-English names

versions.title: Smoother online and saves you can trust
new: Two players on one PC can play online by setting Local players to 2
N64 rooms use the host's save so everyone gets the unlocked boards, characters and cups
improved: Input delay is picked automatically, so games stay at full speed over the internet
Saves never sync while a game is running
fixed: Rooms launch correctly even after someone left and rejoined
A game keeps its save even if the ROM is renamed on another PC
Online sessions no longer leave temporary save files in your vault

versions.title: Friends, invites and the new RetroHub look
new: Friends panel with a shareable friend code, add friends, see who's online and what they're playing
Invite friends to your lobby and they join with one click
Chat with friends, even when they're offline
New RetroHub logo, Start Menu entry and its own taskbar icon

versions.title: Home grouped by genre
improved: Home is grouped by genre, with each game shown once
Rows scroll sideways with the mouse wheel, arrows or dragging
All Games can group by Genre, System or A-Z, with an Online filter

versions.title: Classic Hub becomes RetroHub
new: Now supports N64, GameCube, Game Boy Advance, Game Boy and Game Boy Color
New home screen with Continue Playing, Favorites, Online with Friends and box art
Saves follow you with a sync folder for OneDrive, Dropbox or Google Drive
improved: GBA and Game Boy games resume exactly where you left off
Checks for updates on start and has a Check for updates button

versions.title: Classic Hub launcher
new: Classic Hub library for Smash Classic, Mario Party 1/2/3 and Smash Remix 2.0
Play Online: host a room, share the code, and pick a game everyone owns
Controllers and Settings pages

versions.title: False out-of-sync warning fixed
fixed: Fixed the Out of sync warning appearing at the start of online matches when the fight was actually identical

versions.title: Online start-of-match sync fix
fixed: Online matches no longer go out of sync at the very start
Settings that could change gameplay, like widescreen's effect on Link's boomerang, are neutralized online

versions.title: Online sync fix
fixed: Fixed online matches going out of sync from the first frame
Out-of-sync reports now say which part of the game differs

versions.title: Updater fix
fixed: Updater no longer fails with a file-in-use error; it closes leftover game windows and retries

versions.title: Better post-match flow
fixed: After an online match you now land on the VS menu instead of local 4-player character select
The Online window lets the host start a rematch

versions.title: Online diagnostics
improved: When a match shows Out of sync, the log now records exactly what differs

versions.title: Version checks and logs
new: Logs are now saved in the game's logs folder to help track down problems
improved: Both players must be on the same version to start a match, and the lobby tells you if not

versions.title: Online fixes
new: On-screen warning if a match goes out of sync
After a match, an Online window shows you're still connected, with Start rematch and Leave
fixed: Both players now use the host's gameplay settings, fixing invisible characters
Extra controllers plugged in no longer leak into online matches
Online matches now play identically on Intel and AMD PCs

versions.title: Automatic updates
new: Smash Classic now checks for updates on start and shows what changed
Choose Update now, Later or Skip this version
Updates keep your saves and settings, and restore the old version if anything goes wrong

versions.title: Online play arrives
new: Play Super Smash Bros. 64 online in 1v1 with a 6-character room code
Rollback netcode keeps matches smooth, and no port forwarding is needed
